title: Open-source independent SAT-to-B-rep kernel screen
purpose: Find an eligible ACIS SAT/SAB reader plus B-rep kernel that is independent of Open CASCADE for the selected AC1021 torus semantic gate.

candidateFindings.finding: The project parses SAT/SAB and converts supported geometry through CadQuery/OpenCascade. Its README labels the project experimental and ties support to save-version and producer profile.
candidateFindings.disposition: Independent parser, but not an independent B-rep kernel; it cannot close the kernel-independence gate.

candidateFindings.finding: The pinned parser independently decodes SAT records and exposes typed torus fields. It does not construct or validate a B-rep with a geometric kernel.
candidateFindings.disposition: Independent parser evidence only; existing receipt already records its exact torus-field comparison.

candidateFindings.finding: The repository describes its B-rep kernel as early, says most operations are unwritten, and places ACIS-to-B-rep lifting in a feature layer still under development.
candidateFindings.disposition: Research lead only; no usable SAT-to-kernel route was established in this screen.

localRuntime.result: aborts before startup: Incompatible processor; Qt build requires neon
localRuntime.disposition: The local native FreeCAD runtime cannot perform a new qualification in this environment. The prior ODA/FreeCAD cross-check remains Open CASCADE-based and does not qualify kernel independence.

conclusion: No eligible independent SAT-to-B-rep kernel was found. Keep the independent-kernel gate open; do not promote the existing ACadRust/FreeCAD results to kernel-independent semantics. Resume only with a usable independent kernel implementation or a materially changed native environment.
limits: This is a bounded project/runtime screen, not proof that no suitable independent kernel exists.
No new geometry measurements or support claims are made.
No fixture or downloaded project source was added to the repository.
